description: Experience immersive audio with the Buzz X11 true wireless earbuds, featuring powerful 13mm dynamic drivers for exceptional sound clarity. These sleek blue earbuds come equipped with environmental noise cancellation (ENC) technology to ensure crystal-clear calls and uninterrupted listening. With an impressive 60-hour total playtime and convenient Type-C fast charging that provides 200 minutes of playback from just 15 minutes of charge, your music never stops. The advanced Bluetooth v6.0 connectivity ensures stable, drop-free connection with support for SBC & AAC codecs. Featuring intuitive touch controls and effortless quick pairing, these earbuds offer seamless operation. The ergonomic design provides a comfortable fit for extended wearing, while the charging case's compact form factor makes it perfectly portable. Whether you're commuting, working out, or relaxing, these earbuds deliver a premium audio experience with modern convenience.
